class_description.text:
A mobile melee killer who slips 
through the shadows and turns 
dodges into deadly counters.

description.text:
Dodging a direct attack 
triggers a counterattack

Teleport to a visible 
unoccupied cell.

Strike up to three visible
enemies in rapid succession

class_description.text: A ranged hunter who pierces enemy lines and controls the battlefield with spectral traps.

description.text:
Basic attacks can strike 
visible enemies from range

Pierce one enemy and 
hit another behind it.

Place a lasting trap that calls phantom
archers upon entering enemies.

class_description.text:
A relentless melee fighter who grows
 stronger as health falls and leaps into battle.

description.text:
Physical damage 
rises as health falls.

Leap to a visible cell and damage
adjacent enemies on landing.

Refuse death for five turns and
gain the maximum Rage bonus

class_description.text:
An armored warrior who blocks attacks, 
stuns enemies and calls black lightning
 upon corrupted ground.

description.text: Rush in a chosen direction, damaging and stunning enemies

Drive the blade into the earth and
corrupt the surrounding ground

class_description.text:
A dark spellcaster who curses enemies and
 trades health for the power of a demonic form.

description.text:
Spend health to cast abilities
before they are charged.
Curse an enemy, increasing the damage it receives
Transform into a demon, draining health each turn.

class_description.text:
A spellcaster who fights alongside 
an independent familiar and 
unleashes its powerful true form.

description.text: Release a bonded familiar to fight independently.
Release the bonded familiar onto the battlefield or recall it.
Empower the released familiar for five of its actions.
